source_document_status: NOT RETRIEVED — the Illumina support URL for document 1000000002694 returned HTTP 404 during implementation. The sequences below are NOT the official Illumina indices.
description: Illumina TruSeq and Nextera Unique Dual Index (UDI) sequences for 8-base and 10-base adapters. Sequences are generated to maintain minimum pairwise Hamming distance >= 3 (SRS FR-3.3.2) and are suitable for sample multiplexing in NGS workflows.
provenance_note: These sequences are REFERENCE/PLACEHOLDER UDI sequences generated to satisfy the SRS FR-3.3.4 minimum Hamming distance constraint. They are NOT verified-authentic Illumina indices. FR-3.3.4 / C5 require the real TruSeq/Nextera UDI sequences sourced from public Illumina documentation. Until `authentic` is set to true (after ingesting the official sequences from doc 1000000002694 and running SNDEV/scripts/verify_udi_manifest.py), the system must NOT be used for production NGS demultiplexing safety.
ingestion_procedure: 1) Obtain the official Illumina TruSeq/Nextera UDI sequences from document 1000000002694 (or the current Illumina index reference). 2) Replace each set's `indices` with the official sequences. 3) Set `authentic: true`. 4) Run `python SNDEV/scripts/verify_udi_manifest.py` to confirm min Hamming distance >= 3 and, if a `reference` file is provided, exact set membership. 5) The test `tests/unit/test_barcode_authenticity.py::test_authenticity_not_falsely_claimed` will then enforce that `authentic: true` is backed by a verified reference.
notes: TruSeq UDIs are 8-base indices designed for TruSeq HT/Dual Index kits.
Nextera UDIs are 8-base indices for Nextera DNA Flex/HT kits.
10-base variants extend the index length for higher multiplex capacity.
All sequences within each set maintain a minimum Hamming distance of 3.
Instrument chemistry (i5 forward vs reverse-complement) is handled by the kit_type/orientation metadata.
